column3: “To help,” “you,” “to give,” and “to do likewise” are supplied.
Blessing and covetousness are rendered as a generous gift and giving “not begrudgingly.”
“On every occasion” and “your giving” are supplied.
“The saints” supplies the unexpressed subject; a participle is rendered “will glorify.”
“Will express their affection” supplies a future predicate for the participle longing; “has given” is supplied.
